Hero_Desc_Momo:
A werebeast who dreams of becoming the best ninja in Elias.
Her skills are on display when she carries out the requests of various denizens, but often makes strange mistakes too.
If you have a favor to ask of Momo, make sure to prepare some flower nectar instead of chow.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_Momo: Becoming the Strongest Ninja One Day
Album_Like_Momo: Chow Rebel. Flowers. Nectar. Flower nectar.
Album_Hate_Momo: Flowers without nectar. Slow speech and movement.
Album_Hobby_Momo: Roasting beans with Lightning magic, flower collecting.
Album_Wish_Momo: Finding a real ninja scroll one day.
Album_Momo1: While passing through the Werebeast Forest, I suddenly had the feeling that someone was moving around me at an incredible speed. When I shouted for them to reveal themselves, Momo looked flustered but insisted that the details of her client's request were top secret and that she could never disclose them. I didn't get the full picture, but it was clear she was carrying out some kind of suspicious job.
Album_Momo2: Apparently, Momo is a werebeast who uses Lightning magic. The first time I saw her using magic, I shouted, "Momorisu!" and Momo, liking the sound of it, declared that she would use it as the name of her ninjutsu technique.
Album_Momo3: I questioned why Momo, despite wearing a wingsuit, was still using a kite to glide. At first, she warily said it was rude to pry into a ninja's secrets, but then, in a completely uninterested tone, she admitted that the kite was just for decoration.
Album_Momo4: When I pointed out that slacking off would keep her from becoming a higher-ranked ninja, Momo, with a laid-back expression, asked why that even mattered when she was the only ninja around. When I then asked why she even needed the title of "ninja" in the first place, she flicked my forehead and dashed away.
Album_Momo5: Momo was once an apprentice member of Chow Rebel. When I asked why she left, she said it was to protect everyone's happiness and well-being. I don't know the full story, but it seems like a lot happened.
Album_Momo6: Momo originally acted alone and had little interest in companions or sects. Given her incredible speed and lack of patience, I have a feeling it was nearly impossible for her to cooperate with others.
Album_Momo7: Momo claims she has a jinx where she messes things up if she tries too hard. That's why her motto is, "Let's work hard, but not too hard!" After seeing her completely botch a mission Tig had requested, I immediately understood what she meant.

Food_ChefNote_Momo_Hate1: Imagining this would taste sweet, she looked as if she was about to cry, betrayed by the taste. She's still of pinching her nose.
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Hate2: She shook her head, saying that the peculiar acrid odor of crème brûlée would permeate her body and give her away, even if she used a cloning technique.
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like1: She was delighted to see a jar still full of flower nectar, which she worked hard to gather as a reward for requests made. Saying she'd take it as payment in advance, she offered to carry out a request for me; but what should I ask for?
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like10: Momo stamped her feet because it was delicious but extremely tart. Calling it part of her training, she corrected her posture and continued eating, then began stamping again.
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like2: When she noticed that it was hollow inside the cutlet, her eyes lit up and asked if I'd used some sort of ninjutsu. It didn't disappear somewhere, rather, it was never there in the first place...
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like3: She was pleased, saying that a top-notch ninja should always be well-fed to carry out whatever requests at any time. But since it was too hot for her, she blew on it hard as she ate it.
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like4: She became excited once she saw the way it looked, suddenly using ninjutsu to switch her body with the log. Oh wow, now there are two bûche de noël!
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like5: She said it was a perfect source of nutrition for ninjas who always have to hide somewhere on a mission and stuffed a bunch of them in her pockets.
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like6: She kept fiddling with the songpyeon, then started throwing them into the air, trying to hit them with precision. She said it was part of her daily ninja training, but I gave her an earful for playing with her food.
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like7: She stuffed her mouth with the chocolate, saying that sometimes she prefers something bittersweet like this over the sweetness of honey.
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like8: After looking at the powder intently, she muttered something about using it as a smoke screen instead of flour. I quickly popped it in her mouth before she could do anything weird.
Food_ChefNote_Momo_Like9: Seeming to like them after taking a few bites, she laughed, saying that she wouldn't mind getting paid with this next time.
